english.title: Permit use of a goods vehicle without mirrors maximum gross weight exceeding 12000 kg

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), of a maximum gross weight exceeding 12 tonnes , which was not fitted with **(..SPECIFY MISSING MIRROR(S)..) as specified in item 4 of the table to regulation 33 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 33(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording applies to goods vehicles first used on or after 1.10.88. Items 6 and 7 of the table to regulation 33 govern goods vehicles in use before 1.10.88.
(ii) Regulation 33 also applies conditions and requirements in relation to mirrors fitted. Regulation 33 does not apply to road rollers.
(iii) This offence wording does not apply to an agricultural motor vehicle.
(iv) Instead of complying with regulation 33(1)-(4) a vehicle may comply with the relevant Community Directive referred to in regulation 33(5).
(v) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(vi) See also offence wordings: H3318 and H3322.
